description: This file implements a gRPC-like RPC service framework in Go, including service registration, method invocation, stream handling, and error conversion, specifically for the 'ttrpc' protocol used in containerd.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Represents a stream with associated handler and streaming direction flags.

classes.name: ServiceDesc
classes.description: Describes a service with its methods and streams.

classes.name: serviceSet
classes.description: Manages registered services, interceptors, and handles method calls.

classes.name: streamHandler
classes.description: Handles stream communication, message sending/receiving, and stream lifecycle.

methods.name: newServiceSet
methods.description: Creates a new service set with a specified unary interceptor.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new service description with the service set.

methods.name: unaryCall
methods.description: Performs a unary RPC call with interception and marshaling.

methods.name: streamCall
methods.description: Performs a streaming RPC call with interception and marshaling.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles an incoming request, dispatching to the appropriate method or stream handler.

methods.name: closeSend
methods.description: Closes the send side of the stream.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Sends unmarshaled data into the stream.

methods.name: SendMsg
methods.description: Sends a message over the stream.

methods.name: RecvMsg
methods.description: Receives a message from the stream.
